home_kodiba_tos_p1: KODIBA is a digital-based bamboo savings & loan cooperative and data center helping the community record, store, and develop bamboo information from upstream to downstream. This concept continues the Nusantara bamboo ecosystem movement already developed through the Nusantara Bamboo Community, Nusantara Bamboo Academy, PERPUBI, and Sabumi Nusantara Jaya Foundation.
home_kodiba_tos_p2: Within KODIBA, the community can deposit and store data such as:
home_kodiba_tos_l1_1: amount and type of bamboo seedlings,
home_kodiba_tos_l1_4: number of bamboo clumps and culms,
home_kodiba_tos_l1_6: research results, books, journals, designs, technical guidelines, and other scientific works.
home_kodiba_tos_p3: All of these data can become shared assets beneficial for environmental conservation, research, education, industry, up to community economic empowerment. The concept of collecting a bamboo database as part of bamboo ecosystem preservation and development is also explained in the Bambunusa Group profile.
home_kodiba_tos_p4: As a form of appreciation, every data deposited and verified will be converted into digital value in the form of BMC Tokens, allowing the community, farmers, researchers, lecturers, craftsmen, and elders to gain economic benefits from the knowledge, experience, and data they possess.
home_kodiba_tos_l2_1: help farmers gain access to capital and markets,
home_kodiba_tos_l2_2: preserve bamboo knowledge so it is not lost,
home_kodiba_tos_l2_4: and build a green economy that is fair, open, and sustainable.
home_kodiba_tos_quote: Because every bamboo clump is not just a plant, but a source of life, science, culture, and the future of Nusantara. 🌿
